entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I assist you today?
I need to return an item I bought.
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your order, could I get your name and order number, please?
Alex Chen. Order number is VF-8820-C4.

Thank you, Alex. I see you have the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered about twelve days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
I just don't like it. It's really hard to use and the app is confusing.

I understand that new devices can take some getting used to. Can you tell me which part of the app you're finding confusing? We've found that some features aren't fully explained in the user manual and I might be able to clarify them for you.
I read the user manual. I just expected more from it. I don't want a tutorial, I just want my money back.
Okay, Alex. I understand completely. Let me just review the return policy for your order. One moment please.

Alright, I've checked for you. It looks like you received the item 12 days ago, and our policy states that items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. So you're unfortunately outside that timeframe. I cannot approve this return for you right now.
Fine. About time. Just send me the label.

Of course. I've just processed the return in our system. You will receive an email with the prepaid shipping label and instructions within the hour. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
